accepted.quote: Committee Democrats strongly oppose H.R. 2056, which would effectively nullify laws, policies, and practices duly enacted by the District of Columbia (D.C.), because we strongly support local D.C. self-government.
accepted.rationale: The passage states strong support for local D.C. self-government and opposition to a bill nullifying D.C. laws.

accepted.quote: H.R. 2056 constitutes an unacceptable encroachment on D.C.'s self-governance by mandating that local agencies participate in federal immigration enforcement operations. Such a mandate would undermine community trust and pose a serious risk to public safety.
accepted.rationale: The passage calls mandated local participation in federal immigration enforcement unacceptable and harmful to public safety.
